coverage: Independent sovereign Monaco, grouped under France for navigation only. Current OSM coastline includes the Mareterra reclamation and port basins; territorial waters are excluded. A 100 m corridor reconciles differing land-border surveys to the existing French display. One country shape is provided, not invented administrative subdivisions. Only Monaco’s national flag is shown.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.

coastline.processing: Only coastline ways retained from nine bounding-box responses, with node coordinates joined; all unrelated objects discarded.
